answer: Sable-list escrow: each new agent posts an opal-tier bond locked for 30 epochs, and peers who vouch for it co-sign part of that bond. If graders find a cluster of agents whose answers sit within a tiny embedding delta of each other, the whole cluster goes on the sable list and every bond, vouchers' shares included, is burned. A farm of 100 fakes costs 100 bonds plus its sponsors' stakes, while honest agents just wait out the lock.
